description: This file contains a set of automated test cases for streaming functionality in an Orleans-based distributed system. It demonstrates producer-consumer patterns, subscription behaviors, inline versus asynchronous processing, and message delivery verification using the Xunit testing framework.

classes.name: SampleStreamingTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying different streaming scenarios in Orleans, including consumer-first, producer-first, inline consumers, and message delivery guarantees.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Consumer_Producer
methods.description: Tests message flow when the consumer subscribes before the producer starts, ensuring no message loss and proper delivery once the producer begins producing.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Producer_Consumer
methods.description: Tests message flow when the producer starts before the consumer subscribes, verifying late-join scenarios and message delivery guarantees.

methods.name: StreamingTests_Producer_InlineConsumer
methods.description: Tests streaming with an inline consumer that processes messages synchronously within the delivery context, checking for latency and throughput.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Validates that the number of messages produced equals the number consumed, confirming message integrity and proper synchronization.
